prompt: Create a Python 3.12 application managing products and categories. Every product must belong to an existing category. A category cannot be deleted while products still belong to it.

intentions.text: I can create a new product with a name, SKU, price, and category.
intentions.requires: a product with name, SKU, price, and a valid category name
intentions.observable: The product is added to the system and listed in the product catalog under the specified category.

intentions.text: I can list all products in the system, grouped by category.
intentions.observable: A list of products is displayed, organized by category name.

intentions.text: I can view details of a specific product by its SKU.
intentions.observable: Product details (name, price, category) are displayed for the given SKU.

intentions.text: I can create a new category with a name.
intentions.observable: The category is added to the system and available for product assignment.

intentions.text: I cannot delete a category if it still has products assigned to it.
intentions.requires: a category name that has at least one product assigned
intentions.observable: An error message is shown indicating the category cannot be deleted due to existing products.

intentions.text: I can delete a category only if no products belong to it.
intentions.requires: a category name with no products assigned
intentions.observable: The category is successfully removed from the system.

intentions.text: I can update a product's name, price, or category.
intentions.requires: a product SKU and new values for name, price, or category
intentions.observable: The product's details are updated, and the updated product is reflected in the list.
